scope: Proposition 8.5 of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 89. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem 8.4, with fixed constants, and let da = e−ka be a sufficiently small ancestor depth. Let ω, ν be as above, with fixed kernel comparison constants. Suppose that for every fixed tile enlargement needed below, sup s∈TA(j,x) djM(s) L2(ν) ≤ CAN(j), k0 ≤ j ≤ ka + 3, (8.30) and that Z |P(x + i(H − da))| dω(x) ≤ C N(ka)2 da . (8.31) Then on all finer levels, and with every fixed tile enlargement, sup s∈TA(j,x) djM(s) L2(ν) ≤ C′ AN(j). (8.32) The constants are independent of ka, of ω, and of the finite bootstrap ratio. No higher weighted moment is asserted.
